author: Gundham
body:
Hey people!
As previously mentioned by our Staff Director, Fluenza_, on his thread to announce a big event, the Map Repository would be cleaned, completly erasing the maps that are just corpses lying in there, or maps that do not have as good gameplay as the ones that survived. The repository will now be less cluttered, rotations will be more clean and map-free.

The map rotations are the following (all these changes might not happen immediately):
